contract: c1 apply checksum, verify, rollback, bundle and source digests
notes: manifest is the parsed migration.yaml (JSON data model). projectDefaults is the project configuration's defaults block. files holds UTF-8 file contents; filesHex holds raw bytes as lowercase hex for content a JSON string cannot hold (invalid UTF-8); an absent key is an absent file. expected.applyProjection, verifyProjection and rollbackProjection are the JCS texts of P, V and R. expected.executableText is X(f) of each file (verify.sql is scanned so that a lexically broken file is refused, but its executable text is not hashed); expected.verifySource is S(verify.sql), the file after N1 and N2 that the verify digest frames, or null when absent. sameDigestsAs names a vector with identical digests; compareWith names a vector and lists which digests are equal (same) and which differ (different). The digest layer does not check that files and manifest agree; bundle validation does that separately. expectedError names the first failure and, for SQL errors, the file. Pre-G1 correction (2026-10-05): the verify digest frames the full normalized verify.sql source instead of its executable text.
